crons._comment: Daily at 04:00 UTC — generate upcoming mission occurrences. tickRecurrences caps at 8 occurrences per recurrence per run with a 28-day horizon (src/app/actions/recurrences.ts:296).

Every 15 min during EU business hours, Mon-Fri — runs both 'reminders' (next-day notifications, idempotent via reminder_sent_at) and 'late' alerts in a single tick. Hobby plan caps at 2 cron jobs total.
